name: browns-ota-rate-worksheet
description: Offline CLI that builds a Booking.com / OTA promo + rate worksheet for Nightsbridge review

scripts.test:fixtures: npm run build && node dist/index.js --rates fixtures/sample-rates.csv --promo fixtures/sample-promo.json --outdir out/ && echo 'Fixture test completed successfully'
scripts.test:incomplete: npm run build && node dist/index.js --rates fixtures/sample-rates-incomplete.csv --promo fixtures/sample-promo.json --outdir out-incomplete/ && echo 'Incomplete rates test completed'

author: Grant Brown
